title: Tiger Prawn Jamaican Curry
description: A warm, spicy, and aromatic curry dish from India, made with succulent tiger prawns and a blend of Jamaican spices.
instructions: Heat the coconut oil in a large pan over medium heat.
Add the onion and garlic and sauté until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the curry powder, garam masala, cumin, coriander, and chili flakes. Cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the tiger prawns and cook until pink and fully cooked, about 3-4 minutes per side.
Stir in the coconut milk and bring the mixture to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and let the curry simmer for 5-7 minutes, or until the sauce has thickened.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve the curry hot, garnished with chopped cilantro if desired.
